result.summary: Found 2 issues: a major text truncation problem in the restaurant cards and a layout issue with horizontal scrolling content not being clearly indicated.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is cut off on the right side of the card, likely meant to be 'Trattoria Piccolo' or similar
issues.suggestion: Ensure text has proper padding/margins within cards and doesn't overflow. Consider using text ellipsis with proper styling or adjust card width to accommodate full restaurant names

issues.description: Horizontal scrollable content (category filters and restaurant carousels) lack visual indicators that more items are available, making it unclear to users they can scroll
issues.suggestion: Add scroll indicators, arrows, or a fade-out effect on the right edge of scrollable sections to signal to users that more content is available
